propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts wiki by escaping punctuation inside code spans, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting `-->` delimiters when converting CommonMark to Jira format.

A two-phase lexer must lock complete `{noformat}` spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space-indented blocks before classifying intervening text, preventing pandoc from reaching destructive content.
Code fragments extracted before arrow substitution and verified byte-identical in rendered output; if any fragment is missing or escaped, the entire unit falls back to original Markdown.

A stateless classifier splits wiki markers into UNAMBIGUOUS forms that settle a unit alone (`` `mono` ``, `[label|target]`, `{color:name}`) versus AMBIGUOUS forms that settle only units without CommonMark-only markers, eliminating 2-cycle oscillation in re-renders.

A deterministic corpus of 178 bodies (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) pins rendering fidelity at body-ratio >=0.90 and character-ratio >=0.95 with non-vacuous eligible units dispatched and changed.

Missing pypandoc or conversion/preservation failure returns exact unit or body with content-free `wiki_render_fallback` event; no bodies are logged; existing `WikiTextCodec` methods and live sends remain unchanged.
